status.evidence: According to Companies House and a press release from Scorpion Automotive, Trackershop Limited is active and was acquired by Scorpion Automotive Limited in February 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that its 4G TS10 Hardwired Vehicle Tracker provides 24/7 real-time location visibility and journey insights utilizing cellular updates transmitted directly to the Trackershop app or web platform.
The company reports that its TS10 Hardwired Vehicle Tracker and its MoreFleet 2Wire tracking system utilize the TBC212 GPS tracking hardware manufactured by Vital Telematics Ltd.
Lemlec Ltd. deployed Trackershop LTD’s fleet tracking system, achieving a 10% reduction in fuel costs within the first month and utilizing driving behavior alerts.

The company reports in its data governance documentation that credit/debit card numbers processed through merchant service providers (Sage Pay and World Pay) are not retained within the company's internal servers.
Servo Group announced a partnership with Trackershop in May 2025 to utilize the company's tracking software for exploring new telematics and driving behavior monitoring solutions.

An announced corporate filing on the UK Companies House registry confirms that Scorpion Automotive Limited acquired a position as a person with significant control over Trackershop Limited on December 23, 2025.

Trackershop LTD was acquired by Scorpion Automotive Group (a provider of vehicle security solutions and partner to global manufacturers such as BMW, Subaru, and Yamaha), expanding its corporate distribution ecosystem to reach more installers and trade partners according to a press announcement by Scorpion Automotive.
The company reports that its MoreFleet vehicle tracking system scales to accommodate business fleets ranging in size from 1 to 10,000 vehicles.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its MoreFleet vehicle tracking system scales to accommodate business fleets ranging in size from 1 to 1,000 vehicles.

claims.claim: The company reports a UK operational presence with a head office located at Riverbank House, 1 Putney Bridge Approach in London, alongside a mobile installation team capable of deploying fleet tracking hardware across all UK postcodes.
claims.source: Trackershop UK Official Website (Contact Us & About Us pages)

claims.claim: A data evaluation indicates a localized corporate scale, with a total headcount of 12 employees and customer support availability limited to 08:00–20:00 Monday to Friday and 10:00–14:00 on weekends, rather than 24/7 service.
claims.corrected: A data evaluation indicates a localized corporate scale, with a total headcount of 12 employees and customer support availability limited to 08:00–18:00 Monday to Friday and 10:00–14:00 on weekends, rather than 24/7 service.
claims.source: Trackershop UK Official Website Contact Us Page (Phone Line Opening Times)

status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House records, Fleet Service (Great Britain) Limited is currently operating with an active company status.

claims.claim: A strategic partnership announced in May 2025 integrates Fleet Service GB's core management software with Lightfoot's telematics tools, which utilize 4G LTE connectivity to transmit instant in-cab coaching and vehicle data.

A multi-year partnership with client LiveWest starting in 2019 utilized the Achieve Driver App and driver management system to reduce crash repair costs by 36%, lower CO2 emissions by 58%, and achieve a savings of £86,571 during 2020-2021, according to the Fleet Service GB LiveWest Case Study.

A contract renewal following a 2025 retender with the Canal & River Trust achieved a total savings of £250,000, a 20% reduction in year-on-year spend, and a 12% reduction in fuel usage using the platform's tracking and management tools, according to the Fleet Service GB Canal and River Trust Case Study.

A comprehensive vehicle telematics partnership announced in April 2025 between Fleet Service GB and Lightfoot, which provides in-cab coaching hardware, diagnostic and reporting technology, and onboard driver tools.

Fleet Service GB Ltd maintains a formal privacy policy that defines its alignment with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 under Information Commissioner's Office registration number ZA201610, as detailed in the official Fleet Service GB Privacy Policy.

The company reports within its core software architecture documentation that data collected through its driver systems—including device usage metadata and employer-provided vehicle records—is maintained under an Information Security Management System mapped to the ISO 27001:2013 standard.

In a deployment highlighted in a company case study, the Stannah fleet successfully scaled its operation using Fleet Service GB Ltd's software dashboards to manage a mixed commercial portfolio consisting of 180 cars and 469 vans.

Fleet Service GB secured a sole-supply outsourcing contract announced on June 3, 2019, with housing association LiveWest to manage a fleet of 325 outright purchase vans using its Achieve Driver Management software [https://www.fleetnews.co.uk/news/fleet-industry-news/2019/06/03/livewest-outsources-fleet-management-to-fleet-service-gb].
Financial registry reports from Company Check indicate that Fleet Service (Great Britain) Limited held £1.48 million in cash and achieved a total net worth of £3.85 million.
Commercial market analytics published by RocketReach estimate that Fleet Service GB Ltd has an annual revenue of $12 million.

An integrated technology agreement announced in April 2025 with driver coaching company Lightfoot, which integrates in-cab coaching, diagnostics, and telematics directly into Fleet Service GB's proprietary Achieve software hub.

A national partner framework called the FSGB Garage Network, which consists of a UK-wide partnership of audited independent garages providing coordinated car servicing, MOT testing, and maintenance under a National Pricing Promise.
The company reported managing more than 7,500 cars, vans, HGVs, trailers, and drivers under its Achieve platform.
An external model estimated the company's annual revenue at £14.9 million in May 2026 based on filings.
claims.note: The exact estimated annual revenue of £14.9 million in May 2026 is unconfirmed in published filings or sources.

claims.claim: The company expanded its physical footprint by acquiring new premises at The Stonehouse, Notton Business Park in Lacock, Wiltshire, to accommodate further growth.

The company reports that all driver and vehicle management services are delivered by a dedicated, in-house Service Support Team operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with drivers accessing support directly via phone or its custom Achieve Driver App.
claims.source: Fleet Service GB Official Site (24/7 365 Driver and Customer Support Page & Driver Welcome Page)
